_meta.name: mmm_bayes_hmc
_meta.description: Bayesian media-mix model sampled by static HMC instead of NUTS: FILTER_INCLUDE keeps the east market's weekly series, and ONE REG_MMM_BAYES adstocks TV spend inside the model (geometric, 8-week window) with price as a linear control, with params.sampler hmc. Every transition integrates path_length π/2 (1.5708) — a quarter period of the unit-scale posterior the adapted metric aims at, which carries a draw to a nearly independent point (Stan's 2π would bring it back near its start) — in ceil(path_length / step size) leapfrog steps, the step size adapted during warmup towards target_accept (a fixed params.step_size turns adaptation off). The chains are kept short for a quick run (2 chains of 150 warmup + 100 draws, so expect ess_low warnings). HMC builds no tree, so outputs.diagnostics carries divergences, step sizes and R-hat / ESS but no treedepth_saturated or max_tree_depth; the posterior, outputs.roi and outputs.params read exactly as under NUTS.
